title: Not a Dispatcher
description: Revenue and volume reports are for the business side of SwiftCargo, not the customers whose shipments feed them. Confirm the entire reporting surface stays behind the dispatcher/admin gate.
successCondition: As a logged-in customer, GET /api/reporting/summary?from=2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z&to=2026-02-01T00:00:00.000Z returns 403 with error.code FORBIDDEN. The same query with a driver-role token also returns 403.
hints: The module applies requireRole("dispatcher", "admin") to every route via an app-level preHandler hook — customer and driver are both excluded.

A valid from/to pair is required to even reach the role check in some frameworks' handler ordering — but Fastify's preHandler hooks run before your route's validation, so a bad query alone won't produce this result; use a well-formed query.
